title: hieracium maculatum subsp. onosmotrichum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. onosmotrichum, commonly known as spotted hawkweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family. As a medicinal herb, spotted hawkweed has been used to treat various health issues, including fever reduction, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of spotted hawkweed have been found to exhibit antioxidant and free-radical scavenging activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
